menus.note:
## Toei Shenanigans List:
* 絵コンテ (Storyboard) is NEVER explicitly credited as per usual when someone does both Storyboard/Episode Direction. (絵コンテ・演出 will be used for the sake of our sanity & to be clear)
* On that note, whenever the Storyboard (絵コンテ) role is split with someone else, it's merged into the Episode Director (演出) credit, making it look like there were two episode directors on an episode. When that happens the storyboard role will be included anyways since I disagree with that approach (KOBO-H). (I agree that it looks disgusting to look at -ophi)
* 2nd Key Animation (第二原画) and BANK credits are merged into Key Animation, so some of the 第二原画 credits are presumed purely on the different page or credit block splits in the credits. They're both a lot more harder to spot this time... at least at the beginning anyways
___
The credits missing are the staff for a majority of the BANK sequences, and the rest of the staff for the OP and ED.
